title: KB Istogu win Liga e Pare 2022-2023 season
description: KB Istogu have won Liga e Pare 2022-2023 season as they swept the Final series against Bora 2-0. At first KB Istogu celebrated a 94-81 win and then posted an 85-74 victory. Mirlind Zekaj (196-F/G-2001) top-scored for the winners with 22 points and Arian Azemi (188-G) netted 19. Orges Shatri (194-F-2005) scored 14 and Labinot Kelmendi brought 11. Olsi Kurtaj (195-G-2004) replied with 14 points in the losing effort.
